Remove the connecting plugs , then draw
out the main body .
Clean the relay using a spray .

Connect relay coil terminals ( 5 , 6 ) to

Connect the relay terminals ( 1 , 11 ) to

Adjust output voltage of testing
instrument to equal the operating value of the relay setting and record the

Repeat the step No. 7 for 80% of the
operating value .

Connect the relay terminals again
